name: The Legion of the Waking Dawn
description: A militant populist movement that views all dream-entities and dream-touched phenomena as existential threats to be purged.
goals: Destroy all dream-gates and violently repel any dream-entity incursion
Seize control of Anchorhold defenses from the Veil Wardens
Execute the unlikely guardian, believing it to be a focal point for the degradation
resources: Large militia of fearful citizens, crude but effective anti-psychic weaponry and fortifications, control of key supply lines between Anchorholds.
